title: How this draft was checked
body: A session agent redrafted the page from its blueprint for #71. A fresh fact-checker read 88 claims: 82 held, 5 were imprecise, and 1 was unsupported. The register editor's 26 findings, 6 blocking, were applied, and a recheck's 7 imprecise lines were fixed.

The blueprint was brought in line with the reviewed page after you approved it, so a later redraft keeps every fix. Each change rests on the code or a fact, and none changes the page's sections or the reader's path.

title: The three errors #71 found are gone
body: The page no longer has the reader create `src/access.ts`, which cairn never reads. Only a site whose `migrations/` lacks `0001_roles.sql` copies it. A signed-in role the site never declared sees the welcome view at `/admin` and is refused everywhere else.

title: A new warning: the migration keeps four columns
body: Applying `0001_roles.sql` rebuilds the `editor` table. It keeps every row but only the email, display name, role, and creation time (`migrations/0001_roles.sql`). A site that added its own columns adds them to its copy first. Add a second sign-in group carries the same warning.
